milestone.title: raul TUI path tab — path_view.rs swimlane + keyboard nav + shared palette (M103 TUI follow-up)

intent.outcome: raul TUI gets a Path tab alongside Dashboard / Inbox / Board. The tab renders the 4 mp path lanes (execution / review / grooming / backlog) as columns with per-lane colors drawn from a shared palette. Execution lane shows items as a dep-DAG-connected chain; backlog lane shows priority-ordered cards. Blocked and needs_regrooming surfaces as badges inline. Keyboard navigation uses Tab/Shift-Tab between lanes, h/l or arrows within a lane, Enter to drill into an item. Closes M103 F-01, F-04, F-12, F-13, F-14 — the TUI half deferred from M103's original scope.

problem.description: M103 shipped the CLI swimlane (`raul path --all` / `--lane`) but the TUI tab (`crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs`) was deferred. The TUI today has dashboard / inbox / board / progress / detail tabs but no Path tab. Users who live in the TUI cannot see the same ordered view of the 4 lanes that the CLI exposes. The deferral was tracked (B-62, ID-26, ID-27, M103 F-12..F-14) but never materialized. The M125 milestone covers the CLI graph-rendering follow-up (a separate concern); M126 covers the TUI half specifically.

in_scope: New module: crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs implementing the 4-lane swimlane layout (columns = lanes, per-lane color, execution as dep-ordered chain, backlog as priority-ordered cards)
Wire the Path tab into crates/raul/src/tui/mod.rs and crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs (alongside dashboard/inbox/board)
Keyboard navigation: Tab/Shift-Tab to switch lanes, h/l or arrow keys within a lane, Enter to drill into an item (via existing app dispatch)
Badges: render blocked / needs_regrooming as inline indicators on items in their lane

Shared lane palette: extract lane_color from crates/raul/src/commands/path.rs into a shared module (extend tui/theme.rs or a new palette.rs) so the TUI and CLI render with the same colors (closes M103 ER-8 / F-14)
Empty-lane rendering: clear '(empty)' indicator (matches the CLI behavior at commands/path.rs::format_path_lanes)
Integration tests: render test driving path_view with frozen JSON fixtures (reuse crates/raul/tests/contract/path_lanes_schema.json) + hit-test tests for keyboard navigation
out_of_scope: New mp commands or lane-engine changes (M102 owns the data shape)
Per-terminal narrow-width panic hardening (covered by M105; revisited if path_view has the same render-budget underflow class)

design_decisions.choice: Extend crates/raul/src/tui/theme.rs with a `lane_color(name) -> Color` function (or add crates/raul/src/palette.rs if a separate module is cleaner). The CLI calls the same function via the public re-export.
design_decisions.rationale: One source of truth. The CLI and TUI must render with the same colors so a user switching between `raul path` and the TUI Path tab does not see a color drift.

design_decisions.choice: Wire Path as a new top-level tab in crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs alongside Dashboard / Inbox / Board. Use the same Tab/Shift-Tab dispatch the top-tab nav (M91) already exposes.
design_decisions.rationale: Reuses existing tab infrastructure. No new event-loop code; the dispatch is one match arm.

design_decisions.choice: Reuse the saturated-subtract pattern from crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs::compute_tab_bar_layout when computing per-column widths in path_view. Add a regression test that drives path_view at width=20 and asserts no panic.
design_decisions.rationale: M105 closed the equivalent bug in the tab bar; path_view is the same render class. Audit early to avoid post-merge panic reports.

work_packages.name: Shared lane palette module
work_packages.goal: Extract the lane_color(name) -> Color function out of crates/raul/src/commands/path.rs into a single shared module so the CLI renderer (commands/path.rs) and the new TUI renderer (crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs) emit identical per-lane colors. Closes M103 ER-8 / F-14 (color drift between CLI and TUI). Landing pad: extend crates/raul/src/tui/theme.rs with a public lane_color(name) -> Color fn (preferred — palette is a cross-CLI/TUI concern, and theme.rs already holds color helpers). The CLI re-exports and calls it instead of owning its private copy. After this WP: AC-06 grep gate returns zero Color::Green/Yellow/Blue/Magenta hits for lane colors outside the palette module, and the existing path_lanes_schema.json test stays green.
work_packages.rollback: Move lane_color back into commands/path.rs; remove the re-export.

work_packages.name: path_view.rs core — swimlane layout, badges, empty lanes, narrow-width audit
work_packages.goal: Add the new crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs module that renders the 4 mp path lanes (execution / review / grooming / backlog) as columns with per-lane colors drawn from the shared palette. Execution lane renders items as a dep-DAG-connected chain (topological order from path_engine's lane JSON); backlog lane renders priority-ordered cards. Blocked and needs_regrooming surfaces as inline badges next to their item label. Empty lanes render a clear '(empty)' indicator (matches the CLI behavior at crates/raul/src/commands/path.rs::format_path_lanes). Apply the M105 saturated-subtract pattern when computing per-column widths so the renderer cannot panic under narrow terminals (the M105 entry at crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs::compute_tab_bar_layout is the reference). Consumes the same path-engine JSON the CLI already emits — no mp or path_engine changes. Covers AC-01, AC-02, AC-03, AC-05.
work_packages.rollback: Remove crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs; revert the mod.rs registration.

work_packages.name: Tab wiring + keyboard navigation
work_packages.goal: Wire the new Path tab into crates/raul/src/tui/mod.rs and the App dispatcher in crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs alongside Dashboard / Inbox / Board. Reuse the existing top-tab navigation infrastructure (M91) — the change is a single match arm in the App's tab dispatch, not new event-loop code. Keyboard navigation: Tab / Shift-Tab switches lanes (left/right within the swimlane row); h/l or arrow keys move the cursor within the current lane; Enter drills into an item by reusing the existing drill-detail path (the same one inbox / dashboard already call). Hit-test the navigation matrix in the new tui_path_view integration test. Covers AC-04.
work_packages.rollback: Remove the Path match arm from app.rs; remove pub mod path_view from tui/mod.rs; leave path_view.rs in place but unreachable.

work_packages.name: Integration tests + closure
work_packages.goal: New integration test file crates/raul/tests/tui_path_view.rs covering AC-01..AC-06. Render tests drive the path_view renderer against frozen JSON fixtures reused from crates/raul/tests/contract/path_lanes_schema.json (the M103 contract), parameterized over one fixture per lane scenario: 4-lane populated, execution-dep-chain, backlog-priority-order, empty lanes, narrow-width=20. Hit-test cases for keyboard navigation assert the App state after each key press: Tab shifts lane, Shift-Tab shifts back, h/l and arrows move within the lane, Enter dispatches drill. Add a regression test that drives path_view at width=20 and asserts no panic (closes the M105-equivalent audit). Closure: cargo test -p mp -p raul exits 0, mp validate --summary exits 0; M103 path_cli tests still pass. Covers AC-07.

work_packages.name: Closure
work_packages.goal: Run the full gates: cargo test -p mp -p raul exits 0; mp validate --summary exits 0; mp reviews pass. Mark the open F-01 finding (path_view.rs follow-up) as fixed_in=this milestone. Set evidence fields on the steps that close AC-07.

steps.action: Add a public lane_color(name: &str) -> Color fn to crates/raul/src/tui/theme.rs with the exact same mapping as the existing private fn at crates/raul/src/commands/path.rs::lane_color (blocked=Red, execution=Green, review=Yellow, grooming=Blue, backlog=Magenta, default=White). Export it via pub so the CLI re-export path can pick it up. Verify the M103 path_lanes_schema.json contract test still passes after the export.
steps.done_when: lane_color is pub in theme.rs; color mapping identical to commands/path.rs; path_cli test green

steps.action: Replace the private lane_color fn at crates/raul/src/commands/path.rs with a use of the new shared one (re-export or path-qualified call into tui::theme::lane_color). Delete the local copy. The CLI renderer (commands/path.rs::format_path_lanes) must keep emitting the same colors byte-for-byte (the existing path_cli contract test asserts this).
steps.done_when: commands/path.rs has zero lane-color matches; uses the shared palette; path_cli test green

steps.action: Add a unit test in crates/raul/src/tui/theme.rs (or a small palette test in crates/raul/tests/) that asserts the lane_color mapping for all 5 known lanes (blocked/execution/review/grooming/backlog) plus a default fallback. This is the regression pin: any color drift in the future trips this test. Add the AC-06 grep gate as a docs comment near the test pointing at the verification regex from M126 AC-06.
steps.done_when: lane_palette_mapping test green; the regex gate comment references the M126 AC-06 grep

steps.action: Stub crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs with a render_path_tab(frame: &mut Frame, app: &App, area: Rect, lanes: &serde_json::Value) -> () entry point. Register pub mod path_view in crates/raul/src/tui/mod.rs. Wire the stub into crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs as a no-op match arm under the existing top-tab dispatch (alongside Dashboard / Inbox / Board). Cover the new module so cargo build stays green.
steps.done_when: Build green; Path tab appears in the top-tab nav but renders nothing when selected.

steps.action: Implement the 4-lane column layout in crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs::render_path_tab. Split area.width into 4 roughly-equal columns (use the saturated-subtract pattern from crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs::compute_tab_bar_layout). Each column renders its lane title in the lane's color (drawn from the shared palette at crates/raul/src/tui/theme.rs::lane_color). Empty lanes render a centered '(empty)' indicator (match the CLI behavior at crates/raul/src/commands/path.rs::format_path_lanes).
steps.done_when: Test asserts each lane column emits a header with the expected palette color (parse the rendered Frame buffer with ratatui::backend::TestBackend) and that an empty-lane fixture renders the '(empty)' indicator.

steps.action: In the execution lane column, render items in the lane.items order emitted by path_engine (which is the topological / depends_on chain order from the path_engine — already sorted by the data layer; the renderer just consumes it). Draw a '▶' or '→' connector between sibling items in the column so the chain is visually connected. In the backlog lane column, render items in the order path_engine emits (priority-ordered: high → normal → low). Use the existing item-label formatting from crates/raul/src/commands/path.rs::format_item_label so backlog ids keep their B-/BF-/TW- prefix (no M-prefix).
steps.done_when: Test drives an execution lane with a fixture of M-A → M-B → M-C and asserts the rendered cells contain 'M-A', '▶' or '→', 'M-B', and 'M-C' in column order; a backlog lane fixture with mixed-priority items asserts the rendered order matches the input fixture.

steps.action: Render inline badges next to items that have execution_status=blocked (badge: '[blocked]' in Red) or needs_regrooming=true (badge: '[regroom]' in Yellow). Position the badge after the item label, separated by a single space. The badge renderer is a small helper fn inside path_view.rs (no new module) so the same code can later be reused by other lane views if needed. Tests use a fixture where one item has execution_status=blocked and another has needs_regrooming=true; both expected badges appear, no badge on the rest.
steps.done_when: Test fixture has 3 execution items: one blocked, one regroom, one clean; asserts the rendered Frame contains '[blocked]' and '[regroom]' next to the right items and no badges on the clean one.

steps.action: Audit path_view against the M105 narrow-width panic class. Apply the saturated-subtract pattern at every place we compute a per-column width or per-cell width (the reference: crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs::compute_tab_bar_layout). Add a regression test that drives render_path_tab at width=20 with non-empty lanes and asserts no panic AND that the rendered buffer never exceeds area.width in any row.
steps.done_when: Test passes for area.width in 1..=20 with all 4 lanes populated; no panic; no row exceeds area.width.

steps.action: Extend the existing top-tab dispatch in crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs so the Tab/Shift-Tab keys cycle lanes (Execution → Review → Grooming → Backlog) when the Path tab is active. Reuse the existing TabBarAction surface from crates/raul/src/tui/runner.rs::TabBarAction (M91 already routes left/right). Add a small focused_lane: Option<LaneName> on the App state; Tab advances, ShiftTab retreats, h/l and arrows are handled in S10.
steps.done_when: Test sets the App to Path tab, dispatches Tab, asserts focused_lane moves to next lane (and wraps); dispatches ShiftTab, asserts it moves back.

steps.action: Wire h, l, Left, Right, Up, Down to move the cursor within the focused lane. h/l and Left/Right step within the lane (no lane change); Up/Down cycle items (lane is unchanged). Add cursor_index: usize to the App state, scoped per-lane via Vec<CursorByLane>. Reuse the ListState pattern from crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs that the existing inbox / board views use (do not introduce a new selection model).
steps.done_when: Test sets focused_lane=Execution with 3 items, dispatches Down twice and asserts cursor=2; dispatches Up once and asserts cursor=1; dispatches h and asserts lane is unchanged; dispatches Right and asserts lane is unchanged.

steps.action: Handle Enter on the Path tab by dispatching drill-detail for the selected item (the same dispatch inbox/dashboard use to open the detail pane). For milestone-lane items (M-prefix), this routes to the milestone detail; for backlog items (B-/BF-/TW-), it routes to the backlog item detail. Reuse the existing App.drill_detail_or_back entry point; do not introduce a new dispatch path. Empty lanes (cursor_index >= items.len) ignore Enter.
steps.done_when: Test places an item at cursor=0, dispatches Enter, asserts the App transitioned into the detail view for the matching item id; second test on an empty lane asserts Enter is a no-op (no detail transition).

steps.action: Run the full gate suite: cargo test -p mp -p raul must exit 0; mp validate --summary must exit 0; the existing crates/raul/tests/path_cli.rs (M103) must stay green. mp reviews pass for M126.
steps.tests: cargo test -p mp -p raul && mp validate --summary && mp reviews pass 126
steps.done_when: All three gates exit 0; no regression in path_cli.
